document_status: candidate engineering benchmark authority pending Baraa Misto approval; not authorized for production implementation until approved

exact_conversions.policy: Production uses the authoritative Decimal; RC1 documentary and serialized representations remain unchanged; no binary-float derivation is permitted.

unit_equivalence_policy.basis: Convert stored physical values; do not regenerate the ordinary hole from the alternate printed unit representation.

required_invariants: Increasing valid thickness cannot reduce applicable resistance.
Increasing hole diameter cannot increase net-tension, shear-out, or block-shear resistance.
Changing display units cannot change results, statuses, methods, or fingerprints.
Row-order reversal is prohibited when it changes the physical loaded/free-end meaning.
Existing single-bolt RC2 results and golden hash remain unchanged.
A known numerical failure remains visible even when qualification is also required.
More than three rows may calculate numerically but cannot receive an ordinary ASCE prescriptive PASS.
No equal-share assumption is silently introduced outside an identified method.
The ASCE e1 used by Appendix CA8.3.3 and Equation 8-12 is measured from the unloaded free end to the nearest row.
A plan set with zero required checks is NOT_EVALUATED and never PASS.
Method applicability independently prevents an ordinary ASCE PASS outside prescriptive scope.
Every fingerprinted execution input is deeply immutable or defensively canonicalized before hashing.
Every factor is typed, applied exactly once within its approved scope, and separately retained in trace.
Exact endpoint and candidate ties preserve all co-governing identities in deterministic order.
Block-shear eccentricity classification uses the fingerprinted physical-length tolerance and never rendered geometry.
Force reversal changes physical row ordering and fingerprint while preserving nonnegative demand magnitude.
Each penetrated FRP layer is evaluated independently and remains individually traceable.
Known numerical failure remains FAIL even when qualification, unsupported, or incomplete conditions are also present.

accepted_repository_baseline.commit_subject: fix: correct Stage 2.4A freeze audit and row distributions

eccentricity_classification_policy.relationship_to_canonical_geometry: The planning layer copies the exact canonical geometry distance tolerance into this separately named fingerprinted field.

synthetic_qualified_reference_material_u.purpose: engine-only status and integration benchmarks; not a production material preset

rc2_equation_cases.purpose: Prove ASCE e1 is the distance from the unloaded free end to the nearest row, not a loaded-boundary-to-Row-1 distance.
required_assertions: loaded_boundary_to_row_1_distance_not_e1 is retained only as non-equation geometry.

rc2_equation_cases.purpose: Lock the e1/w = 1 branch boundary and continuity.
source_locators: ASCE/SEI 74-23 Appendix CA8.3.3.2, Eq. CA8-2/CA8-3 or transverse equivalents
required_assertions: Exact equality uses the <= 1 trace branch.
At and just above the boundary produce the same theta = 1 and the same serialized resistance.
No epsilon substitution changes the physical inputs.

rc2_equation_cases.purpose: Exercise shape/plate coefficients in both material directions and lock the controlled transverse-plate source conflict.
Apply C_delta once to applicable FRP in-plane modes and never to metallic bolt strength or pull-through.
Lock property adjustments, connection factors, phi, and lambda as separately traced operations.
Prove exact endpoint ties preserve both endpoints and do not select an arbitrary winner.
Close the source-controlled 0.60 single-lap scope for block shear.
Apply end-use factors independently to both strength components, then apply lap/pitch once to the combined nominal resistance, followed by phi and lambda.
Exercise a native-SI-source hole using +1.6 mm rather than regenerating from the U.S. printed addition.
Lock deterministic concentric/eccentric classification and selected equation at the named physical-length tolerance.

rc2_domain_and_status_cases.precondition: All validated physical inputs appear valid but arithmetic produces nonfinite or nonpositive coefficient/denominator.
